Quick add on network and keystore specifics so Medilabs can triage:

- EU-only hosting: we can pin workloads to AZ/region groups in eu-west-1 (Ireland) or eu-central-1 (Frankfurt). No control plane telemetry or backups are routed outside the region by default; cross-region replication is opt-in and requires documented approval.
- Private connectivity: we support VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink; for PrivateLink we publish an endpoint service and can provide the ARN and acceptance steps.
- KMS/keystore: customer-managed KMS is supported for Private deployments; for Dedicated customers we offer a split-keystore model (customer root + Redwood operational key with limited access). We'll produce a short operator manifest explaining the keystore split and rotation cadence.

Irene
